basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. I work as a software developer during the day, but in my free time, I love diving into the world of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology. I'm fairly new to Reddit, having joined to learn more about investing and staking, especially with Polkadot. When I'm not working or exploring new tech, I enjoy watching supernatural TV shows and keeping up with my favorite reality series. I'm single and often online in the evenings after work, especially around 6-10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and work as a software developer. My interest in cryptocurrencies started about a year ago, and I've been learning through online courses and forums. I enjoy experimenting with staking and other blockchain technologies.
